_README: Human / Planning-Board decisions that OVERRIDE the auto-classification. Keyed by segment id (see work/review.csv). Each entry may set any of: type (S1-S5/R1-R5), ownership, row_ft, traveled_ft, nonconformity, note. These are version-controlled and merged on every pipeline re-run, so adopted decisions survive data refreshes. Example: "main-street-1": { "type": "S1", "nonconformity": "ROW 38 ft, narrower than Type" }

main-street-12.note: Downtown core: Damariscotta bridge -> Glidden St. State Highway (Ownership unchanged); S1 form governs per Section 5.D, realized through Section 12 MaineDOT coordination.

main-street-11.note: Downtown core: Glidden St -> Pump St. State Highway; S1 form coordinated under Section 12.

main-street-10.note: Downtown core: Pump St -> Mills Rd. State Highway; S1 form coordinated under Section 12.

main-street-9.note: Village: Mills Rd -> River Rd. State Highway; S2 form coordinated under Section 12.

academy-hill-2.note: Academy Hill (Route 1 -> E. Old County/Hillcrest): neighborhood street; corrects a Rural Road (R2) trace artifact so all Academy Hill segments are S3.

academy-hill-4.note: Academy Hill (Timber Ln -> Stonebridge Cir): neighborhood street; corrects a Highway Commercial (R4) trace artifact so all Academy Hill segments are S3.
